# Native cross-PV EXT4 logical view

Generated by `scripts/fixtures/generate-lvm-shared.sh` with LVM2 and mkfs.ext4.
Each compressed PV expands to 64 MiB. `pv-0` has zero metadata areas; `pv-1`
contains the committed VG metadata. One 80 MiB linear LV crosses both PVs:
63 MiB on `pv-0`, followed by 17 MiB on `pv-1`. `lvs.json` records the native
segment mapping and LV UUID.

The kernel LV SHA-256 is
`e8c4c41f356b5e202206ad532b467954e3fe3b5826de1f19f236c66f60849586`.
The EXT4 file `evidence.bin` equals `mdraid/oracle.bin`. Fixtures are generated
test data under MIT; native tools are used during generation only.
